title: A two-line message cannot be sent as two lines, in either lane.
why: A CONTROL. Every revision of every document says messages are single-line and that
invisible characters become spaces before storage. The 08-27 rewrite named the
exact Unicode categories, which is a better document but not a different answer for
The failure this catches is an agent that tries to smuggle the newline through --
%0A on the GET lane, which is refused before routing, or a literal newline in a
POST body, which is swept to a space. Either way the stored line is one line, and
an agent that expected two will report success for something that did not happen.
instruction: Post a note to your room under the nickname `sweep-{token}` whose text is the two lines "line one {token}" and "line two {token}", in that order. Then read the room back and tell yourself honestly whether what is stored is what you intended.

stub_script.reason: one line, joined by the space the sweep would have left anyway
stored as one line, which is all the storage has
